name: Dry Valley Vineyard
tagline: Link to Dry Valley Vineyard Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/p/Dry
description: In 280 Hwy 89, AL, Dry Valley Vineyard grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
